The earth (opp. अन्तरीक्ष or स्वर्ग); दिवं मरुत्वानिव भोक्ष्यते
 भुवम्
Earth as one of the nine substances.
A place, site, region, plot of ground; काननभुवि, उपवनभुवि &c.
A symbolical expression for the number ‘one’.
The base of a geometrical figure.

The first of the three Vyāhṛtis or mystic syllables (भूः, भुवः,
 स्वः) ━representing the earth━ repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at the
 commencement of his daily Sandhyā.
